Cincinnati Tornado Monthly Tournament
Held on the Last Saturday of the Month
We provide all clocks & chess sets

Email admin@chessearth: 1.) First & Last Name 2.) USCF ID 3.) Section you are playing in and 4.) Pay $45 at the Tournament Site
On-Site Entry Fee $50; On-Site Registration – By 9:30am Saturday morning deadline
- 10am First Round.

Credit Cards, PayPal, Venmo, CashApp, Zelle, Apple Pay accepted on site
Tournament Address: Wyoming Baptist Church, 170 Burns Ave, Cincinnati, OH 45215
4-Round Swiss Tournament
Time Control: G/45 +5; Each player receives 45 minutes with a +5-second increment. A Tornado is a one-day tournament where you play four games. Cash Prizes and Awards are given at the end of the tournament based on your final score.

Round #2: 12:30pm
Round #3: 2:30pm

JUNE 5-7 OR 6-7, 2026 CONNECTICUT
US CHESS GRAND PRIX POINTS: 60 (ENHANCED)
15th Annual Hartford Open
5-SS, 40/80, SD/30; d30 (2-day option, rounds 1-2 G/60 d10). Sheraton Hotel, 1 Bradley Airport (visible at airport entrance), Windsor Locks CT 06096 (I-91 Exit 40 to Rt 20). Chess rate parking: $5/day, $10 overnight. Prizes $10,000 guaranteed! In 5 sections. Major : Open to 1900/over (see peakrating.us). Prizes. $1200-600-300, top USCF U2300 $400-200. FIDE. Under 2100: $900-500-300, top U1900/Unr $400-200. FIDE. Under 1800: $800-500-300, top U1600 (no unr) $300-150. Under 1500: $700-400-250, top U1300 (no unr) $300-150. Under 1200: $400-200-100. Mixed Doubles Bonus Prizes: Best male+female 2-player team combined score among all sections: $300-150. Team must average under 2200; may play different sections, schedules; register (no extra fee) at site by 2 pm Sat. Unrated prize limits: U1200 $100, U1500 $200, U1800 $300. Remaining balance of a limited prize goes to next eligible player(s). Top 4 sections EF: $93 online at chessaction.com by 6/2, $110 later or at site, until 1 hour before rd 1. U1200 Section EF: all $30 less than above. All: No checks, credit cards OK. GMs $80 from prize. Online EF $3 less to CSCA or WMCA members. Re-entry (no Major to Major) $50. G/45;d5 - Quad Format - No Prizes - All ratings welcome. $10 entry - cash only - Adults and Kids Welcome No Late Entries - No Byes - No Withdrawals ONSITE REGISTRATION ONLY US Chess Membership Required, will affect quick and regular rating.

9:45 AM - Registration Ends (NO LATE ENTRIES)
10:00 AM - Round One

What is Quad Format? Players are grouped in order of rating. The top four are grouped, then the next four are grouped, and so on. The groups (quads) of four play each other in a three-round round-robin. No late entries, no withdrawals . Quads are round robins. Please do not play if you can't stay for all three games. Leaving in the middle of a quad is rude and provides an extreme inconvenience to the other three players in your quad.

Fairfax Chess Tournament 6/6/26
Pozez Jewish Community Center of Northern Virginia
Saturday, June 6, 2026
Event Overview
Register at chessacademy.com/tournaments !
This tournament is for scholastic players in grades K-12 with and without prior tournament experience. We recommend that players in their first tournament choose the Unrated option, where they will be grouped by age and play 3 or 4 games.
Players who've previously done well in an Unrated section or have previous rated tournament experience should choose the Rated option, where they'll be placed in a group of 4 players according to their age and rating. Each participant then plays one game against each of the other three players in their group. At the end of the third game, the winner of each group receives a trophy.
This event should typically finish in 1-2 hours, but can potentially take as long as 3 hours for the most advanced players (although that is rare).
Everyone will use a clock! We'll go over how to use clocks on-site, and you can watch this short video to see how they work. Unrated section players will play a game in 10 minutes with a 5 second delay, and Rated games are 25 minutes with a 5 second delay for each player.
Players can play in the morning at 10am, the afternoon at 1pm, or both!
All sections are non-elimination, and all players participate in all rounds
If you're playing in the Rated sections and have a US Chess ID# and membership, please include it. If you don't have one, we will purchase it for you ($24 value!). If you're not sure what your ID# is you can look it up here
Please arrive 15 minutes before games start. Players who arrive after that may not be placed in quads.
Prices increase by $10 at noon the Tuesday before the tournament.
Questions? Please let us know at Click here to show mail address !

Mixed Doubles: best male/female combined 2-player team score: $1,500-750-350. Average rating below 2200; teammates may play in different sections. Only rounds 1-7 count for Open Section or best day for Beginners. Register on site only (no extra fee) before both players have started round 2.

June FIDE ratings used in Open section, June US Chess ratings in all other sections. Online ratings, CCA minimum ratings or other ratings may be used if higher. Players rated more than 100 points higher than the section limit during the last year may be moved to a higher section. The decision of the chief tournament director regarding eligibility or rating adjustments is final.

Open: $249 by 4/30, $269 by 5/26, $289 later. $400 more for players not rated at least 2200 or FIDE 2100. GM, WGM & foreign IM free by 5/26. $60 discount for other IM or WIM by 5/26.
Under sections: $249 by 4/30, $269 by 5/26, $289 later. $100 play-up fee if rated more than 300 points below section limit or unrated (except U1250).
Beginners: $129 1 day, $189 2 days, $229 3 days, $31 more after 5/26
All: Early Bird Loyalty discount $50 by 1/31 for players who have played in any previous National Open event. Senior (over 65) discount $40 by 5/26. All entry fees $31 more on site.

6/13 - Quad chess tournament G40; d5
Saint Petersburg Chess Club
Saturday, June 13, 2026
Event Overview
There will be no “Byes” or withdrawals allowed. Please complete all your Quad games.
WHAT IS THE QUAD CHESS TOURNAMENT? After all the players have entered, they’re ordered from highest rating to lowest. Unrated players are placed at the low end. The top four players are placed into their own section (a “quad”), then the next four highest in another section, and so on down the list.If two family members are in the same quad, I can move one of them quad up or down.The players in each quad play a round robin, one game against each of the players in their section, for a total of three games each. If there is not an even multiple of four players, the lowest section (usually) will have the few extra players and play a three round Swiss tournament rather than a round robin. The quad format is popular in one day events, and results in players of the most similar playing strengths being paired together for all three rounds. Each group of four chess players is called a Quad.If two family members are at the same Quad,I can move one of them to another Quad.
ADVANTAGES OF QUAD TOURNAMENTS: The advantage of Quad Tournaments, and why players enjoy them so much, is that players of the same strength and experience are able to compete against each other. In addition, the less experienced players are able to win the same "First Place" prizes as their more experienced, stronger counterparts in Quad I and II. You have opportunity your rating to go up faster!!!

PRIZES: $65 for first place at each Quad or 1st place very big trophy (if two players tied for 1st place $33 each or 1st place big trophy each)
Trophies for 1st to 3rd place for last section!

6-round Swiss system.

Ratings
This tournament is USCF-rated , and the official June 2026 USCF ratings will be used.
Byes
Up to two (2) half-point byes is allowed and must be declared during registration.
No additional byes are permitted except for 0-point byes .
A 1-point bye is awarded to a player who is left without an opponent when the number of players is odd in a given round.

$80 – Until June 1, 2026, or for the next 20 players, whichever comes first.

Cancellation & Refund Policy
A 50% refund will be granted if a player requests cancellation by June 11, 2026, at 12:00 AM (midnight) .
No refunds will be issued after this deadline.
Withdrawal Policy
Players must notify an arbiter before the start of a round if they intend to withdraw.
Failure to notify an arbiter may affect eligibility for future tournaments organized by Azeri Chess Academy LLC.

events.sourceText:
Grupology June Rapid Scholastic Tournament
Grupology HQ
Saturday, June 20, 2026
Event Overview
Tournaments take place every month at Grupology HQ in Downtown Burlingame.
Location
Grupology HQ: 1419 Chapin Ave. Suite 101, Burlingame CA 94010
Eligibility
Players must have an active (paid) US Chess Federation membership to compete in the rated sections.
Expiration date of US Chess membership must be later than the day of the tournament.
Check membership status
Become a member or renew your membership
Rapid Tournaments
Sections
K–12th Rated (4 games) 2 or 3 sections depending on number of registrations: 600+, under 600
TDs reserve the right to adjust the sections based on the players signed up to better serve them.
K–5th Non-Rated (4 games)
Schedule
Doors Open: 8:50am
Start Time: Game 1 starts promptly at 9:00am.
Rounds: All sections will play 4 games. This is not an elimination competition. Round 1: 9:00am
Round 2: 9:30am
Round 3: 10:00am
Round 4: 10:30am
End Time: ~11:15am
Byes: Limit one 1/2-point bye if requested prior to the first round. No last round byes.
Time Control: G/15
Rating: Games will be USCF quick-rated.
Notation: Notation not required.

Phoenix Chess Academy
Saturday, June 20, 2026
Event Overview
4 round Swiss. Time control: Game in 25 minutes with 5 sec delay. Boards, sets, clocks and scoresheets will be provided.
Registration: Go to www.phoenixchessacademy.com. USCF membership is required. New or renewing USCF members are welcome. Highest rating will be used for Swiss pairings and prize purposes.
Sections: Open, Under 1700 & Under 1200 (No playing up allowed). Sections will be combined in case a section has less than 4 players registered.
Schedule: Round 1- 9:00 AM, Round 2- 10:05 AM, Round 3- 11:10 AM, Round 4- 12:15 PM. Awards Ceremony will start right after last game is over. Half point Byes are available in all 4 rounds and (Max 2) and must be requested before round 2. Requesting a zero-point bye late in the tournament is considered the same as withdrawing.
Entry Fee: $25.00 by 06/17; $30 by 06/19; $35 same day. Full refund will be issued to players who withdraw at least an hour before the first round. In cases where a registered player does not show up for the tournament without prior notice, they will not be eligible for a refund.
Prizes: Trophies for top three in each section.
A player will automatically forfeit the game if going in the bathroom with a cellphone.

Speedy Quads 68
J. Gilligan's Bar and Grill
Monday, June 22, 2026
Event Overview
Speedy - because the time control is G/5;d0 (each player gets 5 minutes to make all their moves.)
Quads - because we divide the players in groups of four based on ratings or skill level.
Players play two games against each of the three other players in their quad.
We hold a Speedy Quads tournament every fourth Monday each month. Speedy Quads has a FREE entry (but we do accept donations to cover the rating fees). There are no prizes. The games are blitz-rated and do not affect regular or quick ratings.
Time Control is G/5;d0; and we play double-round quads.
Register on site only - please arrive before 7:30pm. US Chess members will play rated quads. Non-members will play in an unrated small Swiss blitz tournament.

Event Overview
US Chess Junior Grand Prix
JUNE 25-29, 2026 DISTRICT OF COLUMBIA
US CHESS GRAND PRIX POINTS: 200 (ENHANCED)
4th annual DC International (in cooperation with the DC Chess Association), 9-SS, 40/80, SD/30; d30, Omni Shoreham Hotel, 2500 Calvert St., NW, Washington, DC 20008. Hotel valet parking is $45/day Chess rate; see chessevents.us for possible offsite public parking options. $20,000 guaranteed prizes in 1 section. FIDE rated; FIDE ratings used for pairings & prizes. GM & IM norms possible. Prizes $6000-4000-2000-1500-1200-800-700-600, clear or tiebreak bonus $200, top FIDE under 2300 $2000-1000. Minimum prize guarantees: If entering online by 6/1 and playing all 9 games (no byes): foreign GM $700, foreign IM/WGM $300. Nonresident aliens: see US tax laws at chessaction.org. EF: GMs, foreign IMs/WGMs: free ( players forfeiting without proper advance notice subject to fine and losing future entry privileges), US IMs, WGMs and foreign FIDE rated players rated 2000/up FIDE: $150 online at chessaction.com by 5/15, $175 by 6/23, $200 later online or at site. Foreign players rated Under 2000 FIDE: $300 online by 5/15, $325 by 6/23, $350 later online or at site. US FIDE Masters : $200 online by 5/15, $225 by 6/23, $250 later online or at site. US players FIDE rated 2200/up: $300 online by 5/15, $325 by 6/23, $350 later online or at site. US players FIDE rated 2000/up: $400 online by 5/15, $425 by 6/23, $450 later online or at site. US players rated under 2000 FIDE or any FIDE unrated: $800 online by 5/15, $825 by 6/23, $850 later online or at site. FIDE might not count players with federation “FID” as foreign players. All: No checks, credit cards OK. Special 1-year USCF dues with magazine: see chessevents.us (USCF membership required). Schedule: Late reg. ends Thu 6 pm, rds Thu 7 pm; Fri 1 & 7 pm, Sat 11 am & 5 pm; Sun-Mon 10 am & 4 pm. Two half point byes available; must commit before rd 3; FIDE norm not possible if taking bye. HR: $169-169-169-169, hotel reservation link at chessevents.us (or call 202-234-0700, mention Chess); reserve early, Chess block may sell out by early June or before. Parking: See chessevents.us for possible offsite parking options. Special car rental rates: Avis, 800-331-1600, AWD #D657633, or reserve car online through chesstour.com . Special rules: Players may not possess cellphones during play; see devicerules.com . Enter online: chessaction.com . No mail entries. Questions: chesstour.com , [email protected] . $15 service charge for refunds. Entries posted at chessaction.com (click “entry list” after entering). Prizes not claimed at site are usually paid through PayPal (may take around 3 weeks). Bring set, board, clock if possible- none supplied. Invitations: [email protected] . Bring set, board, clock if possible- none supplied (top games are assigned to DGT boards by round). Blitz tournament: Sat. 9:30 pm, register on-site Sat. by 9:10 pm.

2026 Castle Chess Grand Prix
Grand Prix
Emory University – Emory Student Center
Friday, June 26, 2026
- Sunday, June 28, 2026
Event Overview
https://castlechess.org/grandprix/
Note “No Spectator” policy!
IMPORTANT – due to the FIFA World Cup Games in Atlanta, out-of-town players should make their travel and hotel arrangements soon!
$12,000 Guaranteed Prize Fund
Dates:
June 26-28, 2026
Location:
Emory University – Emory Student Center
605 Asbury Circle, Atlanta, GA.
Free Parking at Emory is at the Peavine Parking Lot, 29 Eagle Row, Atlanta, GA. Use the covered parking deck – do not park in the outside deck or you will be charged. Allow ~15 minutes to walk from Peavine to the ESC.
Format:
5 rounds. Time Control: G/90, inc/10. 2-day schedule, round 1, G/60, inc/10.
Sections & Prizes:
$12,000 fully guaranteed prize fund in 7 sections.
Master (2200+): $1700 – $1000 – $500; top U2400 : $600 – $300. 80 USCF Grand Prix Points .
Expert (2000-2199): $1000 – $600 – $400.
Class A (1800-1999): $800 – $500 – $300.
Class B (1600-1799): $600 – $400 – $300.
Class C (1400-1599): $500 – $300 – $200.
Class D (1200-1399 or Unrated): $500 – $300 – $200.
U1200 (100-1199 or Unrated): $500 – $300 – $200.
* Strict 100-point rule used for “playing up” a section – see below.
June 2026 US Chess ratings usually used.
100-point Rule: Players rated within 100 points of next section cutoff (June USCF supplement or live rating thereafter) may “play up” a section if they choose to. Example: a player rated 1700 on the June rating list (or live rating thereafter) may play up in Class A if they choose to, but not a player rated 1699.
No exceptions – do not register for a section that you are ineligible for by rating. Erroneous registrations will be moved to the correct section.
Unrated players may enter the Class D or U1200 sections and are eligible for prizes.
Prizes are paid on site on Sunday, June 28 until 5:30pm, or mailed out the week of June 30.
For prizes of $600+, you must fill out a W-9 form with your Tax ID # and address.
Entry Fee :
$125 online by June 23
$140 online after June 23 or on-site (cash only, exact change), at least 45 minutes before game.
Free entries: All GMs, IMs, WGMs : Free online entry . No deduction if registered by June 20, otherwise $125 deducted from prize.
FMs & WIMs currently rated 2200+, All Players currently rated 2400+ . Free online entry . $125 deducted from prize.
Re-entry : $60 online or on-site (cash, exact change).
Campers who pay for the tournament at registration should not register separately.
Registration:
Online registration is strongly recommended!
On-site registration (not recommended): 3-day – Friday 5:15-5:30pm. 2-day/Re-Entry: Saturday 8:45-9:00am. Re-enter online or on-site. Cash only (exact change) on-site.
All registration & re-entry closes 1 hour before game.
Bye request/change deadline: 1 hour before first game.
NO CHECK-IN NEEDED if you register online – just show up for your first game.
Campers who pay for tournament at registration should not register separately.
Schedule:
3-day Schedule (5 rounds):
Friday 6:30pm
Saturday 1:30pm
Saturday 6:00pm
Sunday 9:30am
Sunday 1:45pm
2-day Schedule (5 rounds):
Round 1 – Saturday 10:00am (G/60, inc/10)
Merge with 3-day schedule above starting round 2, Saturday 1:30pm.
Up to two half-point byes available, commit before first round . All byes requested during the tournament are zero points.
Contact:
[email protected] – Chief TD Grant Oen
Notes:
NO SPECTATORS – during active rounds, parents, spectators, and players that have finished their games are not permitted in the playing room or nearby hallways. Only staff and active players may be in the tournament hall and immediate hallways during play.
Boards, sets, and clocks are supplied for the tournament only – bring your own for analysis or skittles.
Withdrawals: Cancellations until June 24 may incur a $5 transaction fee.
50% refunds after June 24 until 90 minutes before round 1.
No refunds for cancellations less than 90 minutes before round 1.
Cancellations, withdrawals, or 0-point byes must be submitted at least 1 hour before the relevant round. Players who “no show” or forfeit a game may incur a $100 fine.
Fair Play Policy will mirror the Charlotte Chess Center’s FPP – leave cell phones and smart watches in your room or car, or store them in a bag or under your chair during your game. No electronics on your person or in your pocket during play.
IMPORTANT – due to the FIFA World Cup Games in Atlanta, out-of-town players should make their travel and hotel arrangements soon!
Campers who are playing the tournament should register for the Grand Prix as part of camp registration and continue their room and board plan through the weekend. Or, if you prefer to stay and eat elsewhere, select “camp only” and register for the tournament separately.

Arizona Golden Cup 🏆
Phoenix Chess Academy
Saturday, June 27, 2026
Event Overview
Arizona's Premier Year - Long USCF Chess Series.
Earn Points. Win Gold. Become a Champion. 🏆
A year-long USCF-rated chess series. Players earn Golden Points at each monthly event. Final standings after December determine the Arizona Golden Cup Champion, 2nd and 3rd Place in each section. Players may enter the series at any time during the year. Tournament is open to everyone. USCF membership is required.
4 Round Swiss G/30; d5 USCF-rated tournament series with cumulative points.
Sections: Open (1800 +). Under 1800. Under 1200. No playing up allowed. Official rating will be used for sections and prizes. Half point Byes available in all 4 rounds (Max 2) and must be requested before round 2. If a player moves to a higher section during the year, points earned in the previous section do not transfer. The player begins earning Golden Cup points in the new section.
Schedule: Round 1: 9:00 AM. Round 2: 10:15 AM. Round 3: 11:30 AM. Round 4: 12:45 PM. Ceremony will follow right after last game is over.
Entry Fee: $35.00 by Wednesday, $40.00 by Friday, $45.00 Same Day. Refund Policy: Full refund if canceling up to 1 hour before the event. No refund after that.
Awards: Top 3 Trophy in each section, Best U1400 and Best U800 in each monthly event.
At the end of the series-After December event: Champion Trophy (in each section) + 7 Months of Free entry for 2027 series. 2nd Place Trophy (in each section) + 5 Months of Free entry for 2027 series. 3rd Place Trophy (in each section) + 3 Months of Free entry for 2027 series. Players are eligible to win only one Arizona Golden Cup prize, awarded in the highest scoring section in which they competed.
Golden Points System:
Finish Points
1st Place 20
2nd Place 16
3rd Place 13
4th Place 10
5–6 8
7–10 5
Participation 3
Bonus Points:
+3 points — Perfect score (4/4).
+2 points (only in December) — Played Most consecutive months.
Monthly Event Tie-Handling (Point Splitting): When two or more players are tied for placement in a monthly Arizona Golden Cup event, Golden points are split evenly among the tied positions.
Tie-Breaks (Year-End):
1. Most 1st-place finishes.
2. Head-to-head results.
3. Most tournaments played.
4. Best December result.
TD decisions are final.

Held on the Last Saturday of the Month

- 10am First Round.

Credit Cards, PayPal, Venmo, CashApp, Zelle, Apple Pay accepted on site
Tournament Address: Wyoming Baptist Church, 170 Burns Ave, Cincinnati, OH 45215
4-Round Swiss Tournament

Chess Social Life.

JUNE 29-30, 2026 DISTRICT OF COLUMBIA
18th annual World Open Under 13 Championship . 6-SS, G/60, d10, Omni Shoreham Hotel, 2500 Calvert St., NW, Washington, DC 20008. Hotel valet parking is $45/day Chess rate; see chessevents.us for possible offsite public parking options. Open to all born after 6/30/13. In 3 sections (unrateds allowed any section). Open Section: Plaques to top 5, top 2 each 1500-1699, Under 1500/Unr; free entry in all CCA over the board tournaments 7/17/26-12/31/26 to 1st, 7/17/26-10/31/26 2nd. Under 1400 Section: Plaques to top 5, top 2 each 900-1099, Under 900/Unr, free entry in all CCA over the board tournaments 7/17/26-10/31/26 to 1st, 7/17/26-9/30/26 2nd. Under 700 Section: Plaques to top 5, top 2 each 300-499, Under 300, Unrated; free entry in all CCA over the board tournaments 7/17/26-10/31/26 to 1st, 7/17/26-9/30/26 2nd. Free Entry Prize Restrictions: Some Continental Chess tournaments have minimum rating requirements for their top sections. Other tournaments charge an extra fee, based on a player’s rating, to play in the top sections. Continental Chess free entry prizes do not cover any such additional surcharges for playing in the top section. Online Entry Fee: $58 at chessaction.com by 6/26, $70 later or at site. Special USCF dues with magazine if paid with online entry: see chessevents.us. USCF membership required. Reg. ends 10 am 6/29. Rounds: Mon 6/29 11 am, 2 pm, 5 pm; Tue 6/30 10 am, 1 pm, 4 pm. June official ratings used, unofficial uschess.org or Online Regular USCF ratings usually used if otherwise unrated. Cannot play below USCF Online Regular Rating - 100 points. No mail entries. $15 service charge for refunds. Entries posted at chessaction.com (click “entry list” after entering). Plaques must be claimed at site. Bring set, board, clock if possible- none supplied.

54th Annual World Open, top 6 sections (Open through Under 1400 Sections)
9-SS, Omni Shoreham Hotel, 2500 Calvert St., NW, Washington, DC 20008. Hotel valet parking is $45/day Chess rate; see chessevents.us for possible offsite public parking options. In 6 sections; top 3 are also FIDE rated. $208,000 guaranteed prizes in these sections; see separate TLA for Under 1200 & Under 1000 sections, June 26-28. Ratings used: July FIDE used in Open. July USCF official used in U2200 to U1400 (unofficial uschess.org or USCF Online Regular Ratings usually used in sections U2200/below if otherwise unrated). Open Section, July 1-5 only: Open to all rated 2200/over USCF or FIDE (others may also enter, but there is an additional $500 surcharge unless rated 2000/above FIDE or 2200/above USCF), 40/90, SD/30; d30. Under 2200 to Under 1400 Sections, July 1-5, 2-5 or 3-5: 40/90, SD/30; d30 ( 4-day option, rounds 1-2 G/60, d10; 3-day option, rounds 1-5 G/35, d10). Cannot play below USCF Online Regular Rating minus100 points in Under 2200 to Under 1400 Sections. Open Section Prizes: $20000-10000-5000-2500-1300-1000-800-700-600-500, clear winner bonus $500, top FIDE 2300-2449 $5000-2500-1500, top FIDE 2200-2299 $5000-2500-1500. Top FIDE U2200/Unr $5000-2500-1500. If tie for first in Open Section, top 2 on tiebreak play speed game 10 pm 7/5 for title and bonus prize. GM & IM norms possible. Prizes for U2200 through Under 1400 Sections: Under 2200: $12000-6000-3000-1500-1000-800-600-500-400-400, top U2100 (no unr) $2000-1000. Under 2000: $12000-6000-3000-1500-1000-800-600-500-400-400, top U1900 (no unr) $2000-1000. Under 1800: $12000-6000-3000-1500-1000-800-600-500-400-400, top U1700 (no unr) $2000-1000. Under 1600: $10000-5000-2500-1300-900-700-600-500-400-400, top U1500 (no unr) $2000-1000. Under 1400: $7000-4000-2000-1200-900-700-600-500-400-400, top U1300 (no unr) $1600-800. Prize limits: 1) If any post-event Regular OTB or Regular Online rating posted 6/29/25-6/29/26, or current Online Regular rating, was more than 40 points over section maximum, prize limit $1000. 2) Players with under 26 lifetime games rated as of July 2026 official list cannot win over $2000 in U1400, $3000 U1600 through U2000. Games rated too late for July official list not counted toward 26 game total. 3) Unrated limit: U1400 $500, U1600 $600, U1800 $800, U2000 $1000, U2200 $1500. 4) Balance of any limited prize goes to next eligible player(s) in line. Mixed Doubles Bonus Prizes: Best male+female combined 2-player team score in Open through U1400: $2400-1200-700-500-300. Team rating must average under 2200; may play in different sections and schedules; register (no extra fee) before both players begin round 2; at least one player on team must be rated, teams including an unrated limited to $300, other prize limits do not apply to Mixed Doubles Team prizes. Entry fee for Open through U1400 sections, online at chessaction.com: $318 by 5/15, $328 by 6/29, $350 at site or online until 90 minutes before round 1. All: $500 extra to play in Open Section unless rated 2000/above FIDE or 2200/above USCF. No checks, credit cards OK. GMs in Open: free ( players forfeiting without proper advance notice subject to fine and losing future entry privileges), $200 deducted from prize. IMs, WGMs in Open: EF $100 less; $100 also deducted from prize. Seniors 65/up: all EF $100 less in U1400 or above sections. No checks , credit cards OK. Re-entry: $160, no re-entry from Open to Open ($500 extra charge to re-enter Open from lower section unless rated 2000 or above FIDE), no re-entry from U1200 or U1000 to U1400 or above. U1200 or U1000 players may also enter U1400 or above, but not as a re-entry. $20 fee for switching section after 6/29. Special 1 year USCF dues with magazine if paid online at chessaction.com with entry: see chessevents.us . 5-day schedule: 7/1 7 pm; 7/2-3 11 am & 6 pm; 7/4-5 10 am & 5 pm. 4-day schedule: 7/2 11 am, 2:30 & 6 pm; 7/3 11 & 6; 7/4-5 10 & 5. 3-day schedule: 7/3 11 am, 1:30, 3:30, 6 & 8:30 pm; 7/4-5 10 & 5. All schedules in U1400 to U2200 merge & compete for same prizes within the section. Half point byes OK all rounds, limit of 3 (limit 2 in last 4 rounds), must commit before round 4. Entries, re-entries close 90 minutes before round. HR: $169-169-169-169, hotel reservation link at chessevents.us (or call 202-234-0700, mention Chess); reserve early, Chess block may sell out by early June or before. Parking: See chessevents.us for possible offsite parking options. Special car rental rates: Avis, 800-331-1600, AWD #D657633, or reserve car online through chesstour.com. Special rules: Players may not possess cellphones during play; see devicerules.com. Enter online: chessaction.com. No mail entry. Questions: chesstour.com, [email protected] . $15 service charge for refunds. Entries posted at chessaction.com (click “entry list” after entering). Prizes not claimed at site are usually paid through PayPal (may take about 3 weeks). Bring set, board, clock if possible- no equipment supplied (about 10 top boards in Open Section assigned to DGT boards per round). Invitations: [email protected] .

Evanston 3x3 July
Levy Activity Center
Saturday, July 11, 2026
Event Overview
3SS G/60, delay 5. USCF Dual Rated
Open to players who are EITHER age 14 and older OR whose US Chess Current Published Regular Rating for the month of the tournament is 900 or higher.
US Chess Membership is required.
Three Sections
Section Gold: 1700 and over (1600 - 1699 may play up to Gold)
Section Silver: 1200-1699 (1100 - 1199 may play up to Silver)
Section Bronze: U1200 and unrated
Sections may be combined at TD discretion. IMPORTANT: We use the US Chess Current Published Regular rating for the month of the tournament to place players in sections. We don’t make exceptions.
Junior players: Junior players (under fourteen years) rated 900+ are welcome. Must be accompanied by an adult throughout the event. We do not accept junior players rated under 900.
Three rounds. Digital clocks are required and will be set to G/60, delay 5. You may take one half-point bye in round 1 or 2.
Prizes: Your prize is an excellent playing experience at a reasonable cost. We've been running these since 2007 and people like playing here.
Entry fee is $20. Please pre-register and pay here when registration opens. Online registration closes when the tournament is full; we don’t have a wait list; we reopen registration if spaces become available.
On-Site Entries: Check evanstonchess.org the morning of the tournament. If space is available on-site entries are $20 cash on an as-available basis starting at 9:00 a.m.
Master and Expert Entries: First two Masters or Experts who sign up get free entry. If your USCF or FIDE regular rating is 2000 or higher, email your name and USCF ID to [email protected] by 5 p.m. the Tuesday before the tournament to pre-register.
Schedule:
Check-in and On-site Registration from 9:00 to 9:30 AM.
Players must check in on the posted registration list by 9:30 am; players who don’t check in receive a half-point bye for the first round or will be paired with another late arrival.
First Round 9:50 am, last round over roughly 5:00 pm.
Bring your lunch! We will have a brief lunch break with no time to go out for food. On-site we have vending machine snacks, coffee and soft drinks.
Other information: Sets supplied. Bring digital delay clocks. Wheelchair accessible. No Smoking. Limit 50 players.
Address: 300 Dodge Ave
Evanston , IL 60202
United States

events.sourceText:
Semper Primus Chess Camp (Open to all K-12)
Millersville University
Sunday, July 12, 2026
- Friday, July 17, 2026
Event Overview
HAVE FUN AND PLAY CHESS!!!
PERFECT OPPORTUNITY TO MAKE FRIENDS!!!!!
https://www.semperprimuschesscamp.com/
Semper Primus Chess Camp is tailored to students entering K-12th grade . All camp Tournaments are Rated .
Overview:
We are an overnight chess camp focused on allowing campers to play and learn about the game we love. Our goal is to bring campers of varying ages and levels together to foster both chess skills and community.
When:
General camp length will be from July 12th – July 17th and July 26th – July 29th (Two great options!)
Campers will have the option to attend camp for 5 or 3 days for the July 12th-17th camp.
Extra day (July 18th) checkout option will be available to campers, as a tournament will be held on July 18th.
Where:
Millersville University, Pennsylvania
Campers have the option to stay in the suites (5th-12th grade), stay in the suites with a parent/guardian (K-4th grade), or commute (K-12th grade).
Double Suite and Single Suite accommodations.
Itinerary:
Campers will have plenty of events to play and compete in.
Recreational activities will be provided in addition to chess to allow campers to rest their minds and relax.
Two daily rated tournaments.
Evening events may include sports, non-chess activities, Blitz, or quick chess.
Freedom of choice is a standard, with camp counselors staying on site 24 hours a day.
Formats include Swiss, Quads, and Blitz.
Master Instruction
​o We will have masters that provide analysis on your games.
​o Daily group lessons on tactics, strategy, openings, and endgames.
o Instruction will be an elective rather than a mandated event.
Note To Parents:
First, I’d like to thank you for considering our Chess Camp. As a father of four I know how important it is to provide them with opportunities to grow. I grew up with 2 brothers and 2 sisters and it was my oldest brother who was born with cerebral palsy that introduced me and taught me the game of chess.
I decided to start up this camp because in my own search for a chess camp had a hard time finding one that allowed for campers to have a full overnight experience, let alone on a college campus. I wanted to have an overnight camp as I find in my dealings with this younger generation that they could use some more time around their peers and making new friends.
I expect to continue to improve the instruction and development of these young minds by bringing in quality Masters who can better their game. I am pleased to already have some talented Masters for or 2024 staff. All chess tournaments are run by a USCF Tournament Director.
Our staff includes a Director, an Assistant Director, a Tournament Director, 3-4 Masters and camp counselors. We typically have a 1/10 ratio of counselors and campers in the suites.
Campers entering 5th through 12th grade may stay in the dorms on their own, while K-4th graders must have a parent/guardian accompanying them. We are equipped to host parents that may want to stay in the area for the week if you don’t mind a suite. Options for 5 night or 3 night stays are available, along with a commuting option. The added day on the registration was designed for parents that don’t want to or can’t pick up their child on Friday but would prefer a Saturday pick up.
If you have any questions, please feel free to contact me directly.
Brian D. Smith
Director

27th annual Pittsburgh Open
Heritage Event, Grand Prix, Enhanced Grand Prix, Junior Grand Prix
Courtyard Marriott University Center Hotel
Friday, July 17, 2026
- Sunday, July 19, 2026
Event Overview
A Heritage Event!
US Chess Junior Grand Prix
JULY 17-19 OR 18-19, 2026 PENNSYLVANIA
US CHESS GRAND PRIX POINTS: 80 (ENHANCED)
27th annual Pittsburgh Open. 5-SS, 40/80. SD/30; d30 (2-day option, rounds 1-2 G/60, d10), Courtyard Marriott University Center Hotel, 100 Lytton Ave, Pittsburgh, PA 15213. $29/day Chess rate parking. Guaranteed prizes $13,000. In 5 sections. Major: Open to 1900/above (see peakrating.us). $1300-700-400-300, clear/tiebreak winner $100 bonus, top USCF U2300 $500-250. FIDE. Under 2100: $1000-500-300-200, top Under 1900/Unr $400-200. FIDE. Under 1800: $900-500-300-200, top Under 1600 (no Unr) $350-180. Under 1500: $800-400-300-200, top Under 1300 (no Unr) $300-150. Under 1200: $500-300-200-100, top Under 1000 (no Unr) $180-90. Mixed Doubles Bonus Prizes: best male+female 2-player team combined score among all sections: $600-300 (teams must have at least one rated player, unrated prize limits do not apply to Mixed Doubles prizes), must average under 2200, may play any sections and schedules, reg. (no extra fee) at site by 2 pm Sat. Unrated prize limits: U1200 $100, U1500 $200, U1800 $400. World Open Rule: Players who scored 8 or more points in 2026 World Open U2200 or below must enter higher section than in World Open. Top 4 sections EF: $118 online at chessaction.com by 7/14, $130 later or at site (no checks, credit cards OK) until 1 hour before round 1. GMs $100 from prize. U1200 Section EF: all $20 less than above. July Official Ratings used; USCF unofficial or USCF Online Regular ratings usually used if otherwise unrated. Special 1 year USCF with magazine if paid online with entry: See chessevents.us. May not play below USCF Online Regular Rating - 100 points. Re-entry $50; no Major to Major. 3-day schedule: Reg ends Fri 6 pm, rds. Fri 7 pm, Sat 11 & 5, Sun 10 & 3:30. 2-day schedule: Reg ends Sat 10 am, rds. Sat 11, 2 & 5, Sun 10 & 3:30. All: Half point byes OK all, limit 2, must commit before round 2. HR: $149-149-149-149, use link at chessevents.us (or call 412-682-6200, request Chess rate); reserve by 6/25 or rate may increase. Prizes not claimed at site usually paid through PayPal (may take about 3 weeks). Car rental: Avis, 800-331-1600, AWD D657633, or reserve car online through chesstour.com. Enter online: chessaction.com . No mail entry. Refunds: $15 service charge. Questions: www.chesstour.com, [email protected] . Entries posted at chessaction.com (click “entry list” after entry) . Bring set, board, clock if possible- none supplied. Blitz tournament Sat 9:30 pm, enter at site Sat. by 9:10 pm.
Address: 100 Lytton Ave
Pittsburgh , PA 15213
United States

events.sourceText:
Arizona Golden Cup 🏆
Phoenix Chess Academy
Saturday, July 25, 2026
Event Overview
Arizona's Premier Year - Long USCF Chess Series.
Earn Points. Win Gold. Become a Champion. 🏆
A year-long USCF-rated chess series. Players earn Golden Points at each monthly event. Final standings after December determine the Arizona Golden Cup Champion, 2nd and 3rd Place in each section. Players may enter the series at any time during the year. Tournament is open to everyone. USCF membership is required.
4 Round Swiss G/30; d5 USCF-rated tournament series with cumulative points.
Sections: Open (1800 +). Under 1800. Under 1200. No playing up allowed. Official rating will be used for sections and prizes. Half point Byes available in all 4 rounds (Max 2) and must be requested before round 2. If a player moves to a higher section during the year, points earned in the previous section do not transfer. The player begins earning Golden Cup points in the new section.
Schedule: Round 1: 9:00 AM. Round 2: 10:15 AM. Round 3: 11:30 AM. Round 4: 12:45 PM. Ceremony will follow right after last game is over.
Entry Fee: $35.00 by Wednesday, $40.00 by Friday, $45.00 Same Day. Refund Policy: Full refund if canceling up to 1 hour before the event. No refund after that.
Awards: Top 3 Trophy in each section, Best U1400 and Best U800 in each monthly event.
At the end of the series-After December event: Champion Trophy (in each section) + 7 Months of Free entry for 2027 series. 2nd Place Trophy (in each section) + 5 Months of Free entry for 2027 series. 3rd Place Trophy (in each section) + 3 Months of Free entry for 2027 series. Players are eligible to win only one Arizona Golden Cup prize, awarded in the highest scoring section in which they competed.
Golden Points System:
Finish Points
1st Place 20
2nd Place 16
3rd Place 13
4th Place 10
5–6 8
7–10 5
Participation 3
Bonus Points:
+3 points — Perfect score (4/4).
+2 points (only in December) — Played Most consecutive months.
Monthly Event Tie-Handling (Point Splitting): When two or more players are tied for placement in a monthly Arizona Golden Cup event, Golden points are split evenly among the tied positions.
Tie-Breaks (Year-End):
1. Most 1st-place finishes.
2. Head-to-head results.
3. Most tournaments played.
4. Best December result.
TD decisions are final.

events.name: Semper Primus Chess Camp (Open to all K-12)
events.sourceText:
Semper Primus Chess Camp (Open to all K-12)
Millersville University
Sunday, July 26, 2026
- Wednesday, July 29, 2026
Event Overview
HAVE FUN AND PLAY CHESS!!!
PERFECT OPPORTUNITY TO MAKE FRIENDS!!!!!
https://www.semperprimuschesscamp.com/
Semper Primus Chess Camp is tailored to students entering K-12th grade . All camp Tournaments are Rated .
Overview:
We are an overnight chess camp focused on allowing campers to play and learn about the game we love. Our goal is to bring campers of varying ages and levels together to foster both chess skills and community.
When:
General camp length will be from July 12th – July 17th and July 26th – July 29th (Two great options!)
Campers will have the option to attend camp for 5 or 3 days for the July 12th-17th camp.
Extra day (July 18th) checkout option will be available to campers, as a tournament will be held on July 18th.
Where:
Millersville University, Pennsylvania
Campers have the option to stay in the suites (5th-12th grade), stay in the suites with a parent/guardian (K-4th grade), or commute (K-12th grade).
Double Suite and Single Suite accommodations.
Itinerary:
Campers will have plenty of events to play and compete in.
Recreational activities will be provided in addition to chess to allow campers to rest their minds and relax.
Two daily rated tournaments.
Evening events may include sports, non-chess activities, Blitz, or quick chess.
Freedom of choice is a standard, with camp counselors staying on site 24 hours a day.
Formats include Swiss, Quads, and Blitz.
Master Instruction
​o We will have masters that provide analysis on your games.
​o Daily group lessons on tactics, strategy, openings, and endgames.
o Instruction will be an elective rather than a mandated event.
Note To Parents:
First, I’d like to thank you for considering our Chess Camp. As a father of four I know how important it is to provide them with opportunities to grow. I grew up with 2 brothers and 2 sisters and it was my oldest brother who was born with cerebral palsy that introduced me and taught me the game of chess.
I decided to start up this camp because in my own search for a chess camp had a hard time finding one that allowed for campers to have a full overnight experience, let alone on a college campus. I wanted to have an overnight camp as I find in my dealings with this younger generation that they could use some more time around their peers and making new friends.
I expect to continue to improve the instruction and development of these young minds by bringing in quality Masters who can better their game. I am pleased to already have some talented Masters for or 2024 staff. All chess tournaments are run by a USCF Tournament Director.
Our staff includes a Director, an Assistant Director, a Tournament Director, 3-4 Masters and camp counselors. We typically have a 1/10 ratio of counselors and campers in the suites.
Campers entering 5th through 12th grade may stay in the dorms on their own, while K-4th graders must have a parent/guardian accompanying them. We are equipped to host parents that may want to stay in the area for the week if you don’t mind a suite. Options for 5 night or 3 night stays are available, along with a commuting option. The added day on the registration was designed for parents that don’t want to or can’t pick up their child on Friday but would prefer a Saturday pick up.
If you have any questions, please feel free to contact me directly.
Brian D. Smith
Director

Friday, July 31, 2026
- Sunday, August 2, 2026
Event Overview
Register here: https://caissachess.net/online-registration/index/8500 . Registration closes exactly 1 hour before the start of round 1:
Where: The Comfort Inn Monticello, 2097 Inn Drive, Charlottesville, VA 22911
Hotel booking link with chess rate($109 + taxes) https://www.choicehotels.com/reservations/groups/ZL28H0
Schedule: Round 1 Friday, 7pm. Rd. 2 Saturday, 11am and Rd. 3, 4pm. Rd. 4 Sunday, 10am and Rd. 5, 3pm.
Time Control: 5 rounds of G90+30s increment per move.
Sections: Championship (minimum rating of 1500 USCF), (U1600-900), (U1000/UNRATED).
Prize fund: $5000, based on 100 entries.
Championship (USCF 1500 minimum): 1st $ 1200, 2nd $600, 3rd $300. Top U-2000 $200. Top U-1800 $200. U1600 (USCF 900 minimum). 1st $700, 2nd $400, 3rd $200. Top U-1300 $200. U1000/UNRATED: 1st $500, 2nd $300, 3rd $200. Trophies for top 3 scholastic players in the U1000 section. Medals for all scholastic players in the U1000 section.
Entry Fee: $100 by May 1st. $110 May 1st - July 17th. $120 after July 17th.
Amenities: Free Parking, all equipment provided, merchandise available, water, coffee and light snacks during games. Casual social event on Saturday evening at the local Dairy Market.
Withdrawals: If you need to withdraw before the tournament, please contact the Charlottesville Chess Club email (see below). A $10 refund fee applies to all refunds. Refunds are not available after the event starts.
Unrated Players: Must play in the U1000 section unless granted special permission by tournament director. Unrated players are only eligible for 50% of any cash prize earned.
Byes: Players may request a maximum of 2 half point (0.5) byes. Bye requests must be placed before July 31st at 11:59pm.
Forfeits: 30-minute no-show policy. The game will be considered a forfeit exactly 30 minutes after the round start time.
Cell phone/device policy: possession of a device that makes a noise during the game will result in an automatic forfeit.
Media policy: Charlottesville Chess Club uses media platforms to promote the club. By registering for this event, I consent to appear in the Club's social media and website posts.
Contact: For questions, or withdrawals prior to the event, email: Click here to show mail address

Tunnelvision XLVII
Columbia Chess Club
Saturday, August 8, 2026
Event Overview
The Columbia Chess Club Presents Columbia Tunnelvision XLVII
August 8, 2026
$1000 Guaranteed
10:30 a.m. 4-Round G/45;inc.5
Columbia Chess Club
6169 St. Andrews Rd.
Columbia, SC 29212
Register
Registration
Standard registration is $40 until midnight on the Thursday before the tournament. $50 late registration thereafter. Registration online only, registration limited to first 74 players.
Entry for titled players (National Master and above) is free, standard entry fee deducted from prizes. If you are a titled player, simply use the "Titled Player" option at checkout.
Considering Tunnelvision as your first chess tournament? Great! We've put together a guide to help first-time players .
Register Now
Pre-Registered Players
Format
4 Round Swiss. Time control is G45/inc.5 (45 minutes starting time with a 5-second increment ), which will be USCF dual-rated under both Quick and Classical. All equipment provided. USCF Rules Apply, active USCF Membership required. Tournament has three sections: Championship (1600+), Under 1600, and Under 1000. Players may register for a higher section if they are within 100 USCF rating points of the cutoff. Players may use either their live standard rating or live quick rating to play in a higher section. Players may not play in a section lower than permitted by their published standard rating.
If you need to renew or obtain a USCF membership, please visit https://new.uschess.org/join-us-chess.
Rules Note: Per USCF Rule 28T, the pairing system will avoid pairing players registered under the same team during the first-half of the event.

All: Unrated may not win over $100 or trophy except for Open section top 4 prizes. Cash prizes for 1st-3rd brilliancy & book prizes for biggest upset rds. 1-5. EF: $99 super-saver by 7/15, $109 early-bird by 7/31, $115 by 8/20, $135 by 8/31, $158 by 9PM on 9/4, $160 on-site. Re-entry $60. Reg.: On-site registration ends 1 hour before 1st rd. Later entries receive ½ point BYE for round 1. Online registration ends 9pm Friday. No phone, US Mail, or email entries. Late registration permitted on-site with up to two ½ point BYEs for missed games.

Sat. 10:00am, 3:30pm;
Sun. 10:00am, 3:30pm;
Mon. 10:00am, 3:30pm.

Online entry at https://www.spacecoastchessfoundation.org/event/floridastatechampionship .

Onsite entry for first round closes at 8:00pm Sunday. Later entries receive ½ point BYE for missed rounds (limit of two ½ point BYEs, with additional missed rounds counting as zero points). Online entry at https://www.spacecoastchessfoundation.org/event/floridastatechampionship .

Evanston Tri-Level September
Levy Activity Center
Saturday, September 12, 2026
Event Overview
4SS G/40, delay 5. USCF Dual Rated
Open to players who are EITHER age 14 and older OR whose US Chess Current Published Regular Rating for the month of the tournament is 900 or higher.
US Chess Membership is required.
Three Sections
Section Gold: 1700 and over (1600 - 1699 may play up to Gold)
Section Silver: 1200-1699 (1100 - 1199 may play up to Silver)
Section Bronze: U1200 and unrated
Sections may be combined at TD discretion. IMPORTANT: We use the US Chess Current Published Regular rating for the month of the tournament to place players in sections. We don’t make exceptions.
Junior players: Junior players (under fourteen years) rated 900+ are welcome. Must be accompanied by an adult throughout the event. We do not accept junior players rated under 900.
Four rounds. Digital clocks are required and will be set to G/40, delay 5. You may take one half-point bye in round 1, 2 or 3.
Prizes: Your prize is an excellent playing experience at a reasonable cost. We've been running these since 2007 and people like playing here.
Entry fee is $20. Please pre-register and pay here when registration opens. Online registration closes when the tournament is full; we don’t have a wait list; we reopen registration if spaces become available.
On-Site Entries: Check evanstonchess.org the morning of the tournament. If space is available on-site entries are $20 cash on an as-available basis starting at 9:00 a.m.
Master and Expert Entries: First two Masters or Experts who sign up get free entry. If your USCF or FIDE regular rating is 2000 or higher, email your name and USCF ID to [email protected] by 5 p.m. the Tuesday before the tournament to pre-register.
Schedule:
Check-in and On-site Registration from 9:00 to 9:30 AM.
Players must check in on the posted registration list by 9:30 am; players who don’t check in receive a half-point bye for the first round or will be paired with another late arrival.
First Round 9:50 am, last round over roughly 5:00 pm.
Bring your lunch! We will have a brief lunch break with no time to go out for food. On-site we have vending machine snacks, coffee and soft drinks.
Other information: Sets supplied. Bring digital delay clocks. Wheelchair accessible. No Smoking. Limit 50 players.

events.name: Tunnelvision XLVIII
events.sourceText:
Tunnelvision XLVIII
Columbia Chess Club
Saturday, September 12, 2026
Event Overview
The Columbia Chess Club Presents Columbia Tunnelvision XLVIII
September 12, 2026
$1000 Guaranteed
10:30 a.m. 4-Round G/45;inc.5
Columbia Chess Club
6169 St. Andrews Rd.
Columbia, SC 29212
Register
Registration
Standard registration is $40 until midnight on the Thursday before the tournament. $50 late registration thereafter. Registration online only, registration limited to first 74 players.
Entry for titled players (National Master and above) is free, standard entry fee deducted from prizes. If you are a titled player, simply use the "Titled Player" option at checkout.
Considering Tunnelvision as your first chess tournament? Great! We've put together a guide to help first-time players .
Register Now
Pre-Registered Players
Format
4 Round Swiss. Time control is G45/inc.5 (45 minutes starting time with a 5-second increment ), which will be USCF dual-rated under both Quick and Classical. All equipment provided. USCF Rules Apply, active USCF Membership required. Tournament has three sections: Championship (1600+), Under 1600, and Under 1000. Players may register for a higher section if they are within 100 USCF rating points of the cutoff. Players may use either their live standard rating or live quick rating to play in a higher section. Players may not play in a section lower than permitted by their published standard rating.
If you need to renew or obtain a USCF membership, please visit https://new.uschess.org/join-us-chess.
Rules Note: Per USCF Rule 28T, the pairing system will avoid pairing players registered under the same team during the first-half of the event.
Live Standings/Pairings/Boards
The top board of each section will be live streamed to the DGT LiveCloud along with real-time updates to Lichess.org and Chess.com. A live video stream of the top Championship board will also be available on the club's Twitch page. See this site's "Live" menu for links.
Live standings (including current pre-registration information) and pairings are also available below.
Live Standings
Prizes
$1000 Prize Fund Guaranteed.
Championship (1600+)
$400 Fund. 1st: $200; 2nd: $130; 3rd: $70
Under 1600
$300 Fund: 1st: $150; 2nd: $100; 3rd: $50
Under 1000
$300 Fund: 1st: $150; 2nd: $100; 3rd: $50
Schedule
Round 1: 10:30 a.m.
Round 2: 12:50 p.m.
Round 3: 2:40 p.m.
Round 4: 4:30 p.m.
Byes
A single half-point bye is available any round, including the final round. The half-point bye may be requested as a part of the advance entry or on site before the tournament starts. Thereafter the only bye available is a zero-point bye. The chief tournament director shall have the ability to grant a half-point bye for any round on unusual circumstances.
Location
Columbia Chess Club
6169 St. Andrews Rd., Ste A
Columbia, SC 29212
Questions?
Email [email protected] or call/text James Brandmair at 803.569.0938.
Parking
The Columbia Chess Club is located in a shopping center with ample parking.
Food
The Columbia Chess Club offers on-site concessions, including drinks and snacks. By the Fire Pizza and Zorba's Restaurant are located in the same shopping center and will be open during the tournament. Many other restaurants are available close by!

events.name: Arizona Golden Cup 🏆
events.sourceText:
Arizona Golden Cup 🏆
Phoenix Chess Academy
Saturday, September 26, 2026
Event Overview
Arizona's Premier Year - Long USCF Chess Series.
Earn Points. Win Gold. Become a Champion. 🏆
A year-long USCF-rated chess series. Players earn Golden Points at each monthly event. Final standings after December determine the Arizona Golden Cup Champion, 2nd and 3rd Place in each section. Players may enter the series at any time during the year. Tournament is open to everyone. USCF membership is required.
4 Round Swiss G/30; d5 USCF-rated tournament series with cumulative points.
Sections: Open (1800 +). Under 1800. Under 1200. No playing up allowed. Official rating will be used for sections and prizes. Half point Byes available in all 4 rounds (Max 2) and must be requested before round 2. If a player moves to a higher section during the year, points earned in the previous section do not transfer. The player begins earning Golden Cup points in the new section.
Schedule: Round 1: 9:00 AM. Round 2: 10:15 AM. Round 3: 11:30 AM. Round 4: 12:45 PM. Ceremony will follow right after last game is over.
Entry Fee: $35.00 by Wednesday, $40.00 by Friday, $45.00 Same Day. Refund Policy: Full refund if canceling up to 1 hour before the event. No refund after that.
Awards: Top 3 Trophy in each section, Best U1400 and Best U800 in each monthly event.
At the end of the series-After December event: Champion Trophy (in each section) + 7 Months of Free entry for 2027 series. 2nd Place Trophy (in each section) + 5 Months of Free entry for 2027 series. 3rd Place Trophy (in each section) + 3 Months of Free entry for 2027 series. Players are eligible to win only one Arizona Golden Cup prize, awarded in the highest scoring section in which they competed.
Golden Points System:
Finish Points
1st Place 20
2nd Place 16
3rd Place 13
4th Place 10
5–6 8
7–10 5
Participation 3
Bonus Points:
+3 points — Perfect score (4/4).
+2 points (only in December) — Played Most consecutive months.
Monthly Event Tie-Handling (Point Splitting): When two or more players are tied for placement in a monthly Arizona Golden Cup event, Golden points are split evenly among the tied positions.
Tie-Breaks (Year-End):
1. Most 1st-place finishes.
2. Head-to-head results.
3. Most tournaments played.
4. Best December result.
TD decisions are final.

events.name: Tunnelvision XLIX
events.sourceText:
Tunnelvision XLIX
Columbia Chess Club
Saturday, October 10, 2026
Event Overview
The Columbia Chess Club Presents Columbia Tunnelvision XLIX
October 10, 2026
$1000 Guaranteed
10:30 a.m. 4-Round G/45;inc.5
Columbia Chess Club
6169 St. Andrews Rd.
Columbia, SC 29212
Register
Registration
Standard registration is $40 until midnight on the Thursday before the tournament. $50 late registration thereafter. Registration online only, registration limited to first 74 players.
Entry for titled players (National Master and above) is free, standard entry fee deducted from prizes. If you are a titled player, simply use the "Titled Player" option at checkout.
Considering Tunnelvision as your first chess tournament? Great! We've put together a guide to help first-time players .
Register Now
Pre-Registered Players
Format
4 Round Swiss. Time control is G45/inc.5 (45 minutes starting time with a 5-second increment ), which will be USCF dual-rated under both Quick and Classical. All equipment provided. USCF Rules Apply, active USCF Membership required. Tournament has three sections: Championship (1600+), Under 1600, and Under 1000. Players may register for a higher section if they are within 100 USCF rating points of the cutoff. Players may use either their live standard rating or live quick rating to play in a higher section. Players may not play in a section lower than permitted by their published standard rating.
If you need to renew or obtain a USCF membership, please visit https://new.uschess.org/join-us-chess.
Rules Note: Per USCF Rule 28T, the pairing system will avoid pairing players registered under the same team during the first-half of the event.
Live Standings/Pairings/Boards
The top board of each section will be live streamed to the DGT LiveCloud along with real-time updates to Lichess.org and Chess.com. A live video stream of the top Championship board will also be available on the club's Twitch page. See this site's "Live" menu for links.
Live standings (including current pre-registration information) and pairings are also available below.
Live Standings
Prizes
$1000 Prize Fund Guaranteed.
Championship (1600+)
$400 Fund. 1st: $200; 2nd: $130; 3rd: $70
Under 1600
$300 Fund: 1st: $150; 2nd: $100; 3rd: $50
Under 1000
$300 Fund: 1st: $150; 2nd: $100; 3rd: $50
Schedule
Round 1: 10:30 a.m.
Round 2: 12:50 p.m.
Round 3: 2:40 p.m.
Round 4: 4:30 p.m.
Byes
A single half-point bye is available any round, including the final round. The half-point bye may be requested as a part of the advance entry or on site before the tournament starts. Thereafter the only bye available is a zero-point bye. The chief tournament director shall have the ability to grant a half-point bye for any round on unusual circumstances.
Location
Columbia Chess Club
6169 St. Andrews Rd., Ste A
Columbia, SC 29212
Questions?
Email [email protected] or call/text James Brandmair at 803.569.0938.
Parking
The Columbia Chess Club is located in a shopping center with ample parking.
Food
The Columbia Chess Club offers on-site concessions, including drinks and snacks. By the Fire Pizza and Zorba's Restaurant are located in the same shopping center and will be open during the tournament. Many other restaurants are available close by!

events.name: Arizona Golden Cup 🏆
events.sourceText:
Arizona Golden Cup 🏆
Phoenix Chess Academy
Saturday, October 24, 2026
Event Overview
Arizona's Premier Year - Long USCF Chess Series.
Earn Points. Win Gold. Become a Champion. 🏆
A year-long USCF-rated chess series. Players earn Golden Points at each monthly event. Final standings after December determine the Arizona Golden Cup Champion, 2nd and 3rd Place in each section. Players may enter the series at any time during the year. Tournament is open to everyone. USCF membership is required.
4 Round Swiss G/30; d5 USCF-rated tournament series with cumulative points.
Sections: Open (1800 +). Under 1800. Under 1200. No playing up allowed. Official rating will be used for sections and prizes. Half point Byes available in all 4 rounds (Max 2) and must be requested before round 2. If a player moves to a higher section during the year, points earned in the previous section do not transfer. The player begins earning Golden Cup points in the new section.
Schedule: Round 1: 9:00 AM. Round 2: 10:15 AM. Round 3: 11:30 AM. Round 4: 12:45 PM. Ceremony will follow right after last game is over.
Entry Fee: $35.00 by Wednesday, $40.00 by Friday, $45.00 Same Day. Refund Policy: Full refund if canceling up to 1 hour before the event. No refund after that.
Awards: Top 3 Trophy in each section, Best U1400 and Best U800 in each monthly event.
At the end of the series-After December event: Champion Trophy (in each section) + 7 Months of Free entry for 2027 series. 2nd Place Trophy (in each section) + 5 Months of Free entry for 2027 series. 3rd Place Trophy (in each section) + 3 Months of Free entry for 2027 series. Players are eligible to win only one Arizona Golden Cup prize, awarded in the highest scoring section in which they competed.
Golden Points System:
Finish Points
1st Place 20
2nd Place 16
3rd Place 13
4th Place 10
5–6 8
7–10 5
Participation 3
Bonus Points:
+3 points — Perfect score (4/4).
+2 points (only in December) — Played Most consecutive months.
Monthly Event Tie-Handling (Point Splitting): When two or more players are tied for placement in a monthly Arizona Golden Cup event, Golden points are split evenly among the tied positions.
Tie-Breaks (Year-End):
1. Most 1st-place finishes.
2. Head-to-head results.
3. Most tournaments played.
4. Best December result.
TD decisions are final.
Address: 18440 N. 7th Street Suite 8.
Phoenix , AZ 85022
United States

Grand Prix Points:
Prize Fund:
FIDE Rated: No
Handicap Accessible: No
Residency Restriction: No
Online Event: No

Phoenix Chess Academy in partnership with Unity Chess Club

- 10am First Round.

Credit Cards, PayPal, Venmo, CashApp, Zelle, Apple Pay accepted on site
Tournament Address: Wyoming Baptist Church, 170 Burns Ave, Cincinnati, OH 45215
4-Round Swiss Tournament
Time Control: G/45 +5; Each player receives 45 minutes with a +5-second increment. A Tornado is a one-day tournament where you play four games. Cash Prizes and Awards are given at the end of the tournament based on your final score.

Evanston 3x3 November
Levy Activity Center
Saturday, November 7, 2026
Event Overview
3SS G/60, delay 5. USCF Dual Rated
Open to players who are EITHER age 14 and older OR whose US Chess Current Published Regular Rating for the month of the tournament is 900 or higher.
US Chess Membership is required.
Three Sections
Section Gold: 1700 and over (1600 - 1699 may play up to Gold)
Section Silver: 1200-1699 (1100 - 1199 may play up to Silver)
Section Bronze: U1200 and unrated
Sections may be combined at TD discretion. IMPORTANT: We use the US Chess Current Published Regular rating for the month of the tournament to place players in sections. We don’t make exceptions.
Junior players: Junior players (under fourteen years) rated 900+ are welcome. Must be accompanied by an adult throughout the event. We do not accept junior players rated under 900.
Three rounds. Digital clocks are required and will be set to G/60, delay 5. You may take one half-point bye in round 1 or 2.
Prizes: Your prize is an excellent playing experience at a reasonable cost. We've been running these since 2007 and people like playing here.
Entry fee is $20. Please pre-register and pay here when registration opens. Online registration closes when the tournament is full; we don’t have a wait list; we reopen registration if spaces become available.
On-Site Entries: Check evanstonchess.org the morning of the tournament. If space is available on-site entries are $20 cash on an as-available basis starting at 9:00 a.m.
Master and Expert Entries: First two Masters or Experts who sign up get free entry. If your USCF or FIDE regular rating is 2000 or higher, email your name and USCF ID to [email protected] by 5 p.m. the Tuesday before the tournament to pre-register.
Schedule:
Check-in and On-site Registration from 9:00 to 9:30 AM.
Players must check in on the posted registration list by 9:30 am; players who don’t check in receive a half-point bye for the first round or will be paired with another late arrival.
First Round 9:50 am, last round over roughly 5:00 pm.
Bring your lunch! We will have a brief lunch break with no time to go out for food. On-site we have vending machine snacks, coffee and soft drinks.
Other information: Sets supplied. Bring digital delay clocks. Wheelchair accessible. No Smoking. Limit 50 players.

Monthly Saturday Swiss
Phoenix Chess Academy
Saturday, November 7, 2026
Event Overview
4 round Swiss. Game in 25 minutes with 5 sec delay. Boards, sets, clocks and scoresheets will be provided.
Registration: Go to www.phoenixchessacademy.com. USCF membership is required. New or renewing USCF members are welcome. Highest rating will be used for Swiss pairings and prize purposes.
Entry Fee: $25.00 by Wednesday; $30 by Friday; $35 same day.
Prizes: Trophies for top three in each section.
Sections: Open, Under 1700 & Under 1200 (No playing up allowed). Sections will be combined in case a section has less than 4 players registered.
Schedule: Round 1- 2:30 PM, Round 2- 3:35 PM, Round 3- 4:40 PM, Round 4- 5:45 PM. Awards Ceremony will start right after last game is over. Half point Byes are available in all 4 rounds and (Max 2) and must be requested before round 2. Requesting a zero-point bye late in the tournament is considered the same as withdrawing.
Refund Policy: Full refund will be issued to players who withdraw at least an hour before the first round. In cases where a registered player does not show up for the tournament without prior notice, they will not be eligible for a refund.
A player will automatically forfeit the game if going in the bathroom with a cellphone.

events.name: PA Team Championship 2026
events.sourceText:
PA Team Championship 2026
Tuscarora Room, Shippensburg University
Saturday, November 7, 2026
- Sunday, November 8, 2026
Event Overview
$1,810 GUARANTEED PRIZE FUND + Plaques/Trophies
(Out of State Players Welcome)
1st Place Team: $600 + Plaques
2nd Place Team: $300 + Plaques
Top U2000 Team: $240 + Plaques (Team average below 2000 US Chess)
Top U1700 Team: $220 + Plaques (Team average below 1700 US Chess)
Top U1400 Team: $200 + Plaques (Team average below 1400 US Chess)
Top Boards 1-4: $50
Top Individual Upset: $50
Top College Team: Trophy
Top Scholastic Team: Trophy
BOARDS PROVIDED. BRING CLOCKS IF ABLE. COFFEE AND WATER PROVIDED. G/90;d5, 5SS
3rd Year in a Row!
2024 Results
2025 Results
October 2026 published ratings will be used for prize eligibility and board order.
Check out the new rules document and FAQs
Team Construction
Teams of 4, up to 1 alternate (ALTERNATE IS OPTIONAL. Up to 5 players on a team)
Team Average Rating MUST be 2200 or below
October 2026 ratings used for pairings and prize eligibility purposes
Unrated players will not contribute to team average ratings. Some exceptions apply (See Rules Document for more information regarding unrated players). If a player has a rating in USCF Quick/Blitz but no USCF Regular rating, then the highest USCF rating can be applied to the team average (Leave comment in
Board order is determined by rating. Switches for board order for players within 50-points are allowed before round 1. (See FAQ for questions)
Each team must have a team captain. The team captain is responsible for ensuring all results are submitted and that players are in the correct board order. Captains are also the first person the tournament director talks to in case of questions or disputes
Looking for teammates or have a team and looking for 1 or 2 additional players? Contact the TD, at Click here to show mail address for help finding teammates
Entry Fee
Early Bird Entry: $120 per team if registered by Sunday, Oct. 11th, 2026
Regular Entry: $160 per team by Nov. 6th
Same-Day Entry: $200 per team. Please register by 9:30am on-site to be paired for round 1
Registration
Teams may register through either option: ONLINE REGISTRATION: COMING IN AUGUST 2026
PDF Registration: (email completed form to [email protected] ): https://drive.google.com/file/d/108hTZzsASgZ0xCL476eks4r7tS9XvjZF/view?usp=sharing
SCHEDULE
Friday, Nov. 6th: FREE BLITZ SIDE EVENT @ 8pm at the playing hall (link coming in August) On-Site Registration ONLY, 7:30pm-7:55pm
Only free for players playing in the main event. $5 entry fee for players not playing in the main event
4 double-round Swiss and $20 to first place (8 games total)
Time Control: G/3;+2
Saturday, Nov. 7th: Format is 5-round Team Swiss, G/90;d5
On-Site Registration: 9am-9:30am
Rounds: 10am-2pm-5:30pm
Sunday, Nov. 8th: Rounds: 10am-2pm
Prizes given out ASAP, no formal prize ceremony
HOTEL
Courtyard by Marriott, 503 Newburd Rd, Shippensburg, PA 17257 12-minute walk through campus to playing hall, 2-minute drive
Other hotel options available, but the Courtyard by Marriott is the only one walking distance
HOTEL LINK WITH GROUP RATE COMING SOON Room must be reserved by Oct. 7th, 2026 to get the group discount.
Check here for other options: https://www.google.com/maps/search/hotels+near+shippensburg+university/@40.0587828,-77.5292696,14.71z/data=!4m8!2m7!5m5!5m4!1s2024-11-15!2i2!4m1!1i2!6e3?entry=ttu
Location Info:
Address: 110 Cumberland Dr, Shippensburg, PA 17257
Playing hall: The playing hall is the Tuscarora Room. After you park behind the building, as you walk around the building counterclockwise, enter the first entrance you see on your left. It should be labeled as the Tuscarora Room. It is on the other side of the building from the main dining hall entrance. Since the room is part of Reisner Dining Hall, you can use Reisner Dining Hall in Google Maps as a reference if you're driving to the playing hall.
Free parking in lot FS-15 (The parking lot behind the playing hall and the dining hall): Link to parking map: https://www.ship.edu/globalassets/visit/parkingmap.pdf
Backup parking lot is lot C-7 in case FS-15 gets too full
We are one of the most central locations in PA.
Distance from Harrisburg: 43 mi (45 mins)
For Philadelphia: Take I-76 and then I-81 S
For Pittsburgh: Take I-76, we’re 16 minutes off the highway. Shorter drive than to Harrisburg.
Distance from Hagerstown, MD : 34 mi (37 mins)
Food Options:
Chick-fil-A across the street (Saturday only)
Snack Shack / Convenience Store across the street (opens at 11)
Many food options 5 minute drive from playing hall
Dining hall adjacent to the playing hall (all you can eat) Prices (Based off Fall 2024 prices):
$9.60 Breakfast (7AM-10:30AM), $11.85 Lunch/Brunch (10AM-2:30PM), $13.55 Dinner ( 3:30pm-8:00pm )

Shippensburg , PA 17257

events.sourceText:
Tunnelvision L
Columbia Chess Club
Saturday, November 14, 2026
Event Overview
The Columbia Chess Club Presents Columbia Tunnelvision L
November 14, 2026
$1000 Guaranteed
10:30 a.m. 4-Round G/45;inc.5
Columbia Chess Club
6169 St. Andrews Rd.
Columbia, SC 29212
Register
Registration
Standard registration is $40 until midnight on the Thursday before the tournament. $50 late registration thereafter. Registration online only, registration limited to first 74 players.
Entry for titled players (National Master and above) is free, standard entry fee deducted from prizes. If you are a titled player, simply use the "Titled Player" option at checkout.
Considering Tunnelvision as your first chess tournament? Great! We've put together a guide to help first-time players .
Register Now
Pre-Registered Players
Format
4 Round Swiss. Time control is G45/inc.5 (45 minutes starting time with a 5-second increment ), which will be USCF dual-rated under both Quick and Classical. All equipment provided. USCF Rules Apply, active USCF Membership required. Tournament has three sections: Championship (1600+), Under 1600, and Under 1000. Players may register for a higher section if they are within 100 USCF rating points of the cutoff. Players may use either their live standard rating or live quick rating to play in a higher section. Players may not play in a section lower than permitted by their published standard rating.
If you need to renew or obtain a USCF membership, please visit https://new.uschess.org/join-us-chess.
Rules Note: Per USCF Rule 28T, the pairing system will avoid pairing players registered under the same team during the first-half of the event.
Live Standings/Pairings/Boards
The top board of each section will be live streamed to the DGT LiveCloud along with real-time updates to Lichess.org and Chess.com. A live video stream of the top Championship board will also be available on the club's Twitch page. See this site's "Live" menu for links.
Live standings (including current pre-registration information) and pairings are also available below.
Live Standings
Prizes
$1000 Prize Fund Guaranteed.
Championship (1600+)
$400 Fund. 1st: $200; 2nd: $130; 3rd: $70
Under 1600
$300 Fund: 1st: $150; 2nd: $100; 3rd: $50
Under 1000
$300 Fund: 1st: $150; 2nd: $100; 3rd: $50
Schedule
Round 1: 10:30 a.m.
Round 2: 12:50 p.m.
Round 3: 2:40 p.m.
Round 4: 4:30 p.m.
Byes
A single half-point bye is available any round, including the final round. The half-point bye may be requested as a part of the advance entry or on site before the tournament starts. Thereafter the only bye available is a zero-point bye. The chief tournament director shall have the ability to grant a half-point bye for any round on unusual circumstances.
Location
Columbia Chess Club
6169 St. Andrews Rd., Ste A
Columbia, SC 29212
Questions?
Email [email protected] or call/text James Brandmair at 803.569.0938.
Parking
The Columbia Chess Club is located in a shopping center with ample parking.
Food
The Columbia Chess Club offers on-site concessions, including drinks and snacks. By the Fire Pizza and Zorba's Restaurant are located in the same shopping center and will be open during the tournament. Many other restaurants are available close by!

https://www.charlottechesscenter.org/events/usmasters
OVERVIEW
The 2026 US Masters is a US Chess National Championship held over Thanksgiving Weekend. The USM is part of the FIDE Circuit and offers GM/IM norms and a $25,000 guaranteed prize fund.
The USM is held just after the Fall GM/IM Norm Invitational and runs alongside the NC Open , an open event for all players.
New this Year:
Higher rating minimums for untitled juniors
Larger female and senior prizes
Adjusted time control from G/90 to G/80, inc/30, allowing for a more relaxed schedule while still being valid for norms, rating, and the FIDE Circuit.
WHEN
November 25-29, 2026 ​
WHERE
Hilton Charlotte University Place
8629 JM Keynes Drive
Charlotte, NC 28262

Please email us if the booking link is not showing the correct rate.

Online registration required .
Online registration closes November 25, 4:00pm
On-site check-in is not necessary for pre-registered players.
ELIGIBILITY
Players rated or once rated 2200+ USCF or FIDE based on an established rating of 26+ games.
Players with the NM, FM, WFM, or higher titles.
CFC and other foreign National Masters accepted.
CM and WCM titles are not considered.
Untitled juniors (born 2007 or after) must be rated 1950+ FIDE and 2100+ USCF at any time between September 1 and November 25; the ratings need not be achieved concurrently. Additional fee applies.
No exceptions to eligibility rules. Players who do not qualify for the USM may enter the NC Open .
Entry fees are based on status at the time of registration.
SPECTATORS
Parents, spectators, and other non-players may attend, but during play, are not permitted in any playing halls or nearby hallways and restrooms.
May enjoy side events and use the hotel common areas.
Anyone may register for the $2,000 Blitz on Saturday.

G/80; inc/30
The USM has been specifically approved by FIDE to be played at a slightly faster classical time control and still be valid for norms, rating, and the FIDE Circuit.

The USM is counted towards the FIDE Circuit , part of the FIDE Candidates cycle. See regulations .

GM, IM, WGM, WIM norms available
Norm “Super Swiss” – normal federation requirement waived
FIDE requires at least one Swiss norm (40+ players) to obtain GM/IM/WGM/WIM titles

Hilton Charlotte University Place

Event Overview
https://www.charlottechesscenter.org/events/ncoblitz
OVERVIEW
The 2026 $2,000 Blitz is a 6 round US Chess and FIDE Blitz-rated event held alongside the US Masters and NC Open . This event is open to everyone but is free for those playing in the US Masters or NC Open.
WHEN
Saturday, November 28
9:00pm
WHERE
Hilton Charlotte University Place
8629 JM Keynes Drive
Charlotte, NC 28262
Free Internet, Free Parking
​
$139/Night
Booking Link - Book ASAP
Click "edit stay" at the top of the booking page to select your exact dates
Please email us if the booking link is not showing the correct rate.
BLITZ REGISTRATION
Open to all players.
On-Site Registration Only , Saturday 4:00-8:45pm.
Entries after 8:45pm receive a round 1 bye.
No online or emailed registration.
Round 1 starts 9:00pm, rounds 2-6 are ASAP.
​
FORMAT
6 single rounds
2 sections (Championship and Under 2000) No playing up unless approved by the Chief Arbiter.
Time Control: G/3, inc/2
November US Chess Regular Ratings are used for pairings and prizes. At the Chief Arbiter’s discretion, live ratings, US Chess Blitz, FIDE Classical or Blitz ratings, or other ratings may be used if higher than US Chess regular ratings.
Sections: Players in the NC Open - Championship section will play in Blitz Championship.
Players in U2000 or lower sections in the main event will play in Blitz U2000.
On-site registered players will play in the section as determined by their rating.
US Chess Blitz and FIDE Blitz rated - US Chess Membership required .

G/3, inc/2

Top U2200 USCF: $100

Free Entry for players in the US Masters, NC Open, or NCO Scholastic.
